source_truth.primary_source: U.S. EPA Office of Water — WATERS Services REST API
source_truth.geofabric: NHDPlus V2.1 (Puerto Rico = VPU 21; Vogel/VPUAttribute extensions unavailable -> attribute_coverage stamped partial)

real_data_sources.aee_incidents: data/aee_incidents.jsonl is the committed reproducible 2025-03-03 SuperSonicHub1 CC0 snapshot at T2/needs_review. Direct MiLUMA town observations are NEVER written over this manifestation: live receipt-bound rows go to gitignored data/luma_live_incidents.jsonl, are deleted before each new live attempt, and are current-state/export eligible only within the AguaYLuz one-hour operational guard. The live request uses the 93-key query vocabulary (78 canonical municipio keys + 15 discovery/locality keys); discovery extras have NO canonical identity effect.
real_data_sources.pr_municipios_geo: data/geo/pr_municipios.json (Census Gazetteer centroids: normalization + spatial joins) + data/geo/pr_municipios.geojson (78 municipio polygons) + data/geo/pr_barrios.geojson (901 barrios, each linked to its municipio) for the map layer; U.S. Census cartographic boundaries (public domain), WGS84
real_data_sources.neon_availability: data/neon_availability.jsonl + data/neon_publication_events.jsonl (NSF NEON API v0, data.neonscience.org/api/v0/sites; Domain D04 'Atlantic Neotropical' = the 4 Puerto Rico sites CUPE/GUAN/GUIL/LAJA). Keyless T1 federal feed: per-site/product availableMonths state and the publication-change delta derived from it (scripts/ingest_neon.py). Licence CC BY 4.0 per NEON's data policy (neonscience.org/data-samples/data-policies-citation-guidelines).
real_data_sources.neon_readings: data/neon_readings.jsonl (NSF NEON API v0 /data/{product}/{site}/{month}; scripts/ingest_neon_products.py). Stream discharge, surface-water elevation and surface-water chemistry at CUPE/GUIL as monitoring_reading rows, daily-aggregated with NEON QA-flagged records dropped. NOTE: this endpoint is token-gated (see waf_blocked_sources) and the live download path is UNVERIFIED — built and tested against synthetic fixtures only, pending a NEON_API_TOKEN. Runtime-only file, not committed, like every other time-series reading source.
real_data_sources.luma_region_status: gitignored data/luma_region_status.jsonl — runtime-only typed point-in-time normalization of MiLUMA GET /miluma-outage-api/outage/regionsWithoutService. Preserves region_raw separately from region_normalized; binds retrieval UTC + exact response SHA-256 from /tmp/luma_snapshot_manifest.json; T2/needs_review. The prior runtime file is deleted before every ingest attempt, including source-unavailable/schema-invalid states; source gaps never synthesize zero and direct MiLUMA rows are not committed/re-published through Git.

source_truth.direct_miluma_handling: INTERNAL_RUNTIME_ONLY: exact direct-MiLUMA response bytes live under /tmp; normalized live town/regional state lives only in gitignored data/luma_live_incidents.jsonl and data/luma_region_status.jsonl. The committed historical CC0 mirror snapshot is a separate manifestation. Normal git add of data/ cannot include the live files.

advisory: PREPS service_events remain island-wide aggregates; per-municipality outage attribution is now provided by aee_incidents (LUMA outages_by_town) at tier T2/needs_review (third-party snapshot) — promote to T1 if/when a direct utility feed is wired

advisory (provenance): aee_incidents is a point-in-time snapshot (2025-03-03); the recommended SuperSonicHub1 mirror is itself inactive since then and the payload carries no timestamps, so a LIVE per-municipio source is required for ongoing attribution; outage start/end + restoration events require a commit-walk + snapshot-diff (future extension)
advisory: source datasets (Energy_Sector, preps_*, outages_by_town.json, Census gazetteer) live outside the repo; ingest scripts default to local paths (override with --src)

water-monitoring analytic layer built: scripts/build_water_alerts.py promotes real EPA SDWIS boil-water + health-based quality violations to CONTAMINATION AlertEvents (T1), plus a T2/needs_review reservoir-low HYDRO_OPS proxy; scripts/build_water_power_crosswalk.py adds water->power `energizes` edges (closes GAP-003); the WATERS NHDPlus enricher is wired (scripts/enrich_waters_nhd.py). Rich asset attributes + energized_by relationships now flow to thehub-pr. Proxies are transparently tier-tagged; T1 unblocks (AAA operating levels, utility feeder map, WATERS key) recorded in docs/ROAD_TO_100.md.

MiLUMA adapter hardening: municipality and regional outage-map surfaces are fetched separately with exact response-byte SHA-256 receipts; town ingest consumes the receipt rather than wall-clock time or the historical mirror default; regional customer aggregates remain a separate typed snapshot dataset and are not promoted into discrete outage-event identity.

MiLUMA request-vocabulary closure: canonical municipio denominator=78; current public tracker vocabulary=93; INTERSECTION=78, CANONICAL_ONLY=0, TRACKER_ONLY=15, UNION=93, SYMMETRIC_DIFFERENCE=15. Tracker-only keys are discovery vocabulary and never identity proof.

Direct MiLUMA publication boundary: historical CC0 data/aee_incidents.jsonl stays versioned; direct utility observations are runtime-only/gitignored, cleared on failed refresh, age-gated, and never overwrite the historical manifestation.

centinelas_pr_only_gaps: PREB (Puerto Rico Energy Bureau) regulatory filings: document-based portal, no structured API — centinelas-pr monitors filings and sends signals via ingest_news_event.py until PREB publishes a machine-readable feed

AAA/PRASA boil-water notices: the AAA portal is a Webflow marketing site with no public API — SDWIS T1 microbial violations (ingest_sdwis_violations.py) are the authoritative regulatory boil-water signal; individual AAA press-release notices route through centinelas-pr -> ingest_news_event.py at T3
waf_blocked_sources: MiLUMA / api.miluma.lumapr.com: Incapsula WAF blocks plain automated access; GET /miluma-outage-api/outage/regionsWithoutService was independently observed returning HTTP 403 on 2026-09-19. fetch_luma_live.py attempts low-frequency browser-header access to both known outage-map surfaces (municipality/towns and regionsWithoutService), unlinks stale temp outputs before access, freezes exact response bytes + SHA-256 receipts when successful, and records/propagates source gaps without synthesizing current data. A formal PREB/LUMA data-sharing arrangement remains the durable path to T1 attribution.

NEON /api/v0/data/{product}/{site}/{month} (data.neonscience.org): returns HTTP 403 {'error':{'status':403,'detail':'Access Denied'}} to anonymous callers — NEON's own gateway, verified against sibling paths on the same host that answer 200. Requires a free NEON API token (data.neonscience.org/myaccount) sent as the X-API-Token header; note that an INVALID token also yields 403, even on endpoints that are open anonymously. Activate via refresh.py --weekly/--all (optional step: scripts/ingest_neon_products.py prints a skip notice and exits 0 when the token is absent). NEON *metadata* — sites, products, releases, and the availableMonths publication signal this producer's alerts are built on — needs no credential and is unaffected.
